svg.title: Four verdicts from one evidence archive
svg.desc: One sealed archive of three files, checked four ways. Intact archive: verified, exit 0. One byte changed: failed, exit 2. Required artifact missing: not-established, exit 3. Verifier changed: verified, exit 0. The intact archive is read by the verifier and, the same archive, by the changed verifier; each prints its own receipt, and both receipts are kept in one binder.
